pairs.subject: ability-authoring-to-engine
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/tags/TagAuditSection.tsx:130 The tag audit panel gates only on a live parse with declared tags, so an empty referenced set still renders as a 0/100 score with every tag orphaned instead of as unmeasured, and the panel never shows which authoring surface contributed each reference.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/tags/TagAuditSection.tsx:42 Both directions and the named lists are shown, but the totals carry no per-surface attribution: appReferenced is never read by this panel, and its only consumer (the data.ts:687 category) feeds TAG_AUDIT_CATEGORIES, which no .tsx renders. Losing the app-spec source would just improve the score with nothing going visibly empty. The unmeasured guard also sits in the caller and misses the referenced-empty case (spellbookView.ts:74 tests only live.tags.length).

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/tags/TagAuditSection.tsx:127 The tag surface reads out a reconciliation and briefs no generator; grep of gas-balance/ and tags/ for prompt, buildPrompt, TaskFactory and useModuleCLI found nothing.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/tags/TagAuditSection.tsx:14 This context consumes an already-normalized breakdown; the cross-dialect comparison happens upstream in src/lib/ability and is judged under ability-design.
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/gas-balance/GASBalanceHeader.tsx:26 The only export is a scenario code copied to the clipboard; no code generation run exists to report on.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/gas-balance/balanceFixes.ts:2 Scenario changes are deterministic solved levers, which the technique excludes as mechanical; no model edits an artifact here.
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/gas-balance/data.ts:255 The validated input is a scenario code pasted by a person, not a generator's return shape.
